item.text: I can’t reliably determine the maximum-scoring schedule by hand, and I don’t want to present an unverified schedule as optimal. The constraints require checking many possible start times, team assignments, travel gaps, and lunch breaks; I can’t substantiate a total-points claim without that optimization.
